messages:
danielle: Hey team — Empire (fintech) asked for a perf plan. They want steady 400–600 qps, 2s tail latency max, and a weekend stress run. Need: test plan, script, infra sizing recommendation, and quick pricing estimate. Who can lead?
ash: I can own the run. Quick clarifying q: is that 400–600 concurrent requests or arrival rate (RPS)?
kevin: They mean RPS (arrival). Their app fans out 1:1 to Redwood for completions. So 400–600 requests/s to our endpoint.
maria: FYI region is eu-west-1 only for the POC. No multi-region needed.
ash: OK. Proposed workload shapes:
- steady-state 450 rps for 2h
- spike to 900 rps for 5m every 30m (burst test)
- gradual ramp 0→700 over 20m
I’ll run with k6 for generator. Example snippet:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'x'.repeat(200)}), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer REDACT' } });
  sleep(0.002);
}
```
kevin: Two important server-side notes:
1) Use model-small-quant when you need cost-sensitive throughput tests.
2) For latency SLOs run a KV-cache warmup (prefix caching) for 30m before measuring.
maria: Also ensure token limits per request — specify max_tokens. We should test median vs p95 vs p99 latency slices.
ash: Agree. I'll publish an artifacts folder with raw logs + summarized CSV. Plan to use our ingest pipeline and trace IDs so Console can correlate traces.
danielle: Pricing ask — customer wants est monthly infra cost if this is steady 500 rps prod. Can you do a quick calc?
kevin: Quick back-of-envelope: 500 rps * avg 32 tokens = ~16k tokens/s -> ~1.4B tokens/day. With model-small-quant at $0.0006 / 1k tokens that's about $840 / day -> ~$25k / month. That's infra + some buffer; we should present tiered options and mention Dedicated reserved discounts.
ash: I'll include two options in the writeup: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) and Dedicated (3-node reserved pool) with expected latency percentiles and cost bands.
sales_ops_bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/benchmarks/EMP-3987 :eyes:
maria: Quick checklist before run:
- confirm test account API key (dev key vs prod rate limits)
- open a temporary Dedicated pool if we want deterministic latency
- add canary routing so prod traffic doesn't mix
- enable detailed logging for traces
kevin: One more enterprise blocker that popped up in their security questionnaire: they require KMS key usage for logs. We can support with Private deployments or Dedicated with KMS bind. Flagging for AE.
danielle: Noted — I'll surface KMS constraint in next customer call and propose Dedicated with KMS, or hosted with logs redaction if they insist on hosted.
ash: Scheduling: I'll run smoke tomorrow 0900 UTC, full stress on Saturday 0200 UTC (eu-west-1). Will paste results and graphs here.
danielle: Thanks. Can we also add a short section in the report about graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model + queueing) so they see reliability options?
kevin: Yes, include fallback policy: latency hedge to model-tiny + token limit reduction, plus circuit-breaker after 5s queue wait.
ash: ack, will draft an executive summary + technical appendix with raw k6 commands, vegeta alternatives, and cost calc.
maria: If you need infra help ping me. I can provision a Dedicated trial for the weekend.
danielle: Perfect — appreciate it. Please keep notes brief and paste key numbers. :thumbsup:
